cards.name: All
cards.summary: Selects every unlocked, visible object in the document, across all artboards. If the Type tool has a text cursor in a frame, Ctrl+A selects all of that story's text instead.
use_for: grouping or scaling a whole finished layout
applying one recolour or stroke change to the entire artwork
copying all artwork into another document
avoid: multi-artboard files where only one artboard should move: use All on Active Artboard
locked or hidden objects are left out: unlock (Object > Unlock All) or show them first if they must be included
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("selectall") (id paired by its shortcut, not confirmed by execution); DOM alternative: set pageItem.selected = true for each top-level item (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: All on Active Artboard
cards.summary: Selects all unlocked, visible objects that sit on the active artboard, leaving art on the other artboards unselected.
use_for: moving or scaling one poster size in a multi-size campaign file
copying one artboard's layout into a new artboard or document
exporting the art of a single social-post artboard
avoid: objects that straddle two artboards are caught too: check the selection before deleting
the wrong artboard being active: click the artboard (Artboard tool or Artboards panel) first
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("selectallinartboard") (id paired by its shortcut, not confirmed by execution); DOM: app.activeDocument.artboards.setActiveArtboardIndex(n) then app.activeDocument.selectObjectsOnActiveArtboard()

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Deselect
cards.summary: Clears the selection so no object is selected; nothing in the artwork changes.
use_for: clearing the selection before setting default fill / stroke for new shapes
starting a fresh selection in a script or action
checking the artwork without bounding boxes and anchor points on top
avoid: a later step still needs these objects: save them first with Select > Save Selection..., because Reselect repeats a Select command and does not bring the old selection back
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("deselectall") (id paired by its shortcut, not confirmed by execution); DOM: app.activeDocument.selection = null

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence); avoid: removed the unsupported claim that Esc deselects and the self-contradicting 'keep selected' entry; now Save Selection before deselecting

cards.name: Edit Selection...
cards.summary: Opens the Edit Selection dialog, which lists the named selections saved with Select > Save Selection and lets you rename or delete them. It has nothing to manage until at least one selection has been saved (it is expected to be dimmed until then; not checked in this harvest).
use_for: tidying named selections in a complex illustration (e.g. 'all outlines', 'background shapes')
renaming saved selections before handing a template to another designer
avoid: saving a new selection: use Save Selection...
saved selections that point to deleted objects: re-save them rather than renaming
cards.how: Pick a saved selection in the list, then type a new name or click Delete; OK closes. Saved selections are recalled from the bottom of the Select menu.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Selection Hat 11") opens the dialog only (id paired by partial word match and order, not confirmed by execution). No DOM access to saved selections is known (unverified).

cards.name: Inverse
cards.summary: Swaps the selection: everything that was unselected becomes selected and the current selection is dropped. Locked and hidden objects stay out.
use_for: selecting everything except a logo or hero object to dim, lock or move it
deleting all the background clutter around one kept element
isolating one element by selecting it, inverting and hiding the rest
avoid: objects inside groups behave as the group unless selected with the Direct / Group Selection tool: check what the inverse actually caught
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Inverse menu item") (id paired by its words and parent menu, not confirmed by execution); DOM alternative: toggle pageItem.selected on each top-level page item (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Next Object Above
cards.summary: Moves the selection to the object directly above the currently selected one in the stacking order; nothing is restacked, only the selection moves. Needs one selected object.
use_for: stepping through tightly stacked shapes that are hard to click
reaching an object hidden behind a larger shape on top
avoid: changing the stacking itself: use Object > Arrange > Bring Forward
objects buried in a big file: the Layers panel is faster for jumping far
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Selection Hat 8") (confirmed by a live test: selection moved from the bottom object to the one above it)

cards.name: Next Object Below
cards.summary: Moves the selection to the object directly below the currently selected one in the stacking order, without restacking anything. Needs one selected object.
use_for: selecting a background shape covered by artwork on top
stepping down through overlapping layers of a pattern or illustration
avoid: sending the object backward in the stack: use Object > Arrange > Send Backward
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Selection Hat 9") (id paired by its shortcut; not confirmed by execution, its sibling Selection Hat 8 is)

cards.name: All on Same Layers
cards.summary: Selects every object on the same layer (or layers) as the current selection. Needs at least one selected object to say which layer is meant.
use_for: grabbing a whole 'text' or 'background' layer of a poster from one object on it
moving or recolouring everything on a layer without opening the Layers panel
avoid: selecting a layer you can see in the Layers panel: clicking its target circle does the same
locked or hidden objects on the layer are not selected
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Selection Hat 3"). The id was paired from Keyboard Shortcuts dialog order only and is not confirmed by execution: test it once before relying on it. DOM alternative: app.activeDocument.selection[0].layer.hasSelectedArtwork = true (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: placeholder 'selectedItem' replaced with the real path app.activeDocument.selection[0]

cards.name: All Text Objects
cards.summary: Selects every text object in the document (point type, area type and type on a path) and nothing else.
use_for: converting all type to outlines before sending a logo or print file
changing the font or colour of all copy at once
checking which elements of a layout are still live text
avoid: only point or only area type is wanted: use Point Type Objects or Area Type Objects
locked or hidden text is skipped: unlock / show it first when outlining for print
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Text Objects menu item") (id paired by Keyboard Shortcuts dialog words and order, not confirmed by execution); DOM alternative: set selected = true on each item of app.activeDocument.textFrames (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Area Type Objects
cards.summary: Selects every area type object (text flowed inside a frame or shape) in the document, leaving point type and type on a path unselected.
use_for: setting columns, inset or baseline options on all text frames via Area Type Options
converting all area type to point type in one pass
finding text frames that may have overset text before print
avoid: all text is wanted: use All Text Objects
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483840. DOM substitute: select each app.activeDocument.textFrames item whose kind == TextType.AREATEXT (unverified)

cards.name: Bristle Brush Strokes
cards.summary: Selects every path painted with a Bristle brush. Bristle strokes print and export as many transparent objects, so this is the way to find them before expanding or rasterising.
use_for: finding painterly bristle strokes to expand or rasterise before sending a file to print
swapping all bristle strokes to a lighter brush when a file becomes slow
avoid: all brush types are wanted: use Brush Strokes
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483929. DOM substitute: none known, no DOM property exposes a path's brush type

cards.name: Brush Strokes
cards.summary: Selects every path that has any brush applied (calligraphic, scatter, art, pattern or bristle).
use_for: expanding all brushed strokes (Object > Expand Appearance) before handing off a file
swapping every brushed line to another brush in one click
finding brush strokes that slow a file down
avoid: only bristle brushes are wanted: use Bristle Brush Strokes
plain stroked paths are not caught: use Select > Same > Stroke Color / Stroke Weight for those
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Brush Strokes menu item") (id paired by its words and parent menu, not confirmed by execution); no DOM property exposes a path's brush, so there is no known scripted substitute

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Clipping Masks
cards.summary: Selects every clipping path (the mask shape of each clip group) in the document, not the artwork it clips.
use_for: finding and deleting stray clipping masks that come in with PDF or stock files
adding a stroke or colour to all mask shapes at once
checking a file for hidden clipped artwork before print
avoid: the clipped artwork itself is wanted: enter the clip group or use Object > Clipping Mask > Release
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Clipping Masks menu item") (id paired by its words and parent menu, not confirmed by execution); DOM alternative: select pathItems whose clipping property is true (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Direction Handles
cards.summary: Selects all the direction handles of the anchor points on the selected paths, so they can be scaled or moved together (for example to round out or tighten every curve at once). Needs selected paths.
use_for: scaling every curve handle of a logo outline in one step to make it rounder or sharper
editing handle lengths across many anchors without clicking each one
avoid: moving anchor points rather than handles: select the points with the Direct Selection tool
smoothing a path automatically: Object > Path > Simplify is easier
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Selection Hat 1"). The id was paired from Keyboard Shortcuts dialog order only and is not confirmed by execution: test it once before relying on it. DOM alternative: edit each PathPoint's leftDirection / rightDirection directly (unverified)

cards.name: Point Type Objects
cards.summary: Selects every point type object (text placed with a single click, with no frame) in the document, leaving area type and type on a path unselected.
use_for: converting all point type headlines to area type for frame-based layout
restyling every headline or label set as point type
finding loose text labels before outlining
avoid: all text is wanted: use All Text Objects
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483839. DOM substitute: select each app.activeDocument.textFrames item whose kind == TextType.POINTTEXT (unverified)

cards.name: Stray Points
cards.summary: Selects every isolated single anchor point (a path with one point) in the document. They print nothing but clutter the file, and are usually left by stray pen-tool clicks.
use_for: cleaning a logo or icon file before delivery
finding invisible junk points that throw off bounding boxes and alignment
avoid: removing stray points, unpainted objects and empty text paths in one go: use Object > Path > Clean Up
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Stray Points menu item") (id paired by its words and parent menu, not confirmed by execution); DOM alternative: select pathItems whose pathPoints.length == 1 (unverified)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Reselect
cards.summary: Repeats the most recent Select > Same or Select > Object command, using the current selection as the new reference (for example after Select Same Fill Color on a red shape, select a blue one and Reselect to get all blue shapes). Needs a selection command to have been used first.
use_for: working through a palette colour by colour with Select Same Fill Color
repeating a Select Same query on another reference object quickly
avoid: restoring the previous selection itself: it re-runs the command, it does not recall the old set of objects; use Save Selection for that
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Find Reselect menu item") (id paired by its shortcut, not confirmed by execution)

review.changes: script_api: added that the id is inferred, not confirmed by execution (batch evidence)

cards.name: Appearance
cards.summary: Selects all objects whose whole appearance (fills, strokes, effects, opacity and blend mode, as listed in the Appearance panel) matches the selected object. Needs a selected reference object.
use_for: finding every button or badge built with the same multi-fill / effect stack
restyling all objects that share a look, then saving it as a graphic style
avoid: matching one attribute only (e.g. one drop shadow): use Appearance Attribute
objects that look alike but differ slightly in one setting are not caught
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483827. DOM substitute: none known, the DOM does not expose the full appearance stack

cards.name: Appearance Attribute
cards.summary: Selects all objects that share one appearance attribute of the selected object, typically the same applied effect (such as the same drop shadow), even if their fills and strokes differ. Which attribute is matched when the reference object carries several was not tested in this harvest.
use_for: finding every object carrying the same drop shadow or glow to edit or remove it
auditing where one effect is used across a layout
avoid: matching the full look: use Appearance
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483828. DOM substitute: none known

cards.name: Blending Mode
cards.summary: Selects all objects that use the same transparency blending mode (Multiply, Screen, Overlay ...) as the selected object. Needs a selected reference object.
use_for: finding every Multiply shadow or Screen highlight to adjust them together
checking a print file for blend modes that may flatten badly
avoid: objects with Normal mode match all other Normal objects, which is usually most of the file
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Find Blending Mode menu item") (id paired by partial word match and order, not confirmed). DOM alternative: compare pageItem.blendingMode (unverified)

cards.name: Fill & Stroke
cards.summary: Selects all objects that match the selected object on both fill colour and stroke colour, so a red shape with a black outline only catches other red-with-black shapes. Whether stroke weight is compared too was not checked in this harvest.
use_for: recolouring one exact fill-and-outline combination in an icon set or map
finding shapes styled one particular way in a cartoon or infographic
avoid: matching fill only: use Fill Color
matching stroke only: use Stroke Color
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Find Fill & Stroke menu item") (id paired by partial word match and order, not confirmed)

cards.name: Fill Color
cards.summary: Selects all objects with the same fill colour as the selected object, whatever their stroke. With global or spot colours, the General preference Select Same Tint % decides whether different tints of that colour also match.
use_for: swapping a brand colour everywhere in a layout
unifying a colour in an infographic or icon set
finding objects that use a wrong colour before print
avoid: near-identical colours (e.g. 254 vs 255 red) are not matched: use Edit > Edit Colors > Recolor Artwork or the Magic Wand tool with a tolerance
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Find Fill Color menu item") (id paired by partial word match and order, not confirmed)

cards.name: Font Family
cards.summary: Selects every text object set in the same font family as the selected text, whatever the style or size (e.g. all Montserrat, Regular to Black). Needs selected text. How frames that mix several fonts are matched was not tested.
use_for: replacing a client font across a whole brochure or deck
outlining or restyling every use of one typeface
avoid: replacing fonts in place across the file: Type > Find/Replace Font is more direct
only one weight should change: use Font Family & Style
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483833. DOM substitute: compare textFrame.textRange.characterAttributes.textFont.family with the reference (unverified)

cards.name: Font Family & Style
cards.summary: Selects every text object in the same font family and the same style as the selected text (e.g. only Montserrat Bold), at any size. Needs selected text.
use_for: changing every bold headline at once without touching body copy in the same family
swapping one weight for another (Bold to SemiBold) across a layout
avoid: size must match too: use Font Family, Style & Size
the whole family is wanted: use Font Family
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483834. DOM substitute: compare textFont.family and textFont.style of characterAttributes (unverified)

cards.name: Font Family, Style & Size
cards.summary: Selects every text object that matches the selected text on font family, style and point size together, i.e. text set exactly the same way. Needs selected text.
use_for: restyling every caption or label set in one exact type spec
applying a new character or paragraph style to all text of one spec
avoid: text that differs by a fraction of a point is missed: use Font Family & Style, which ignores size (Font Size needs the exact size too)
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483835. DOM substitute: compare textFont.family, textFont.style and characterAttributes.size (unverified)

review.changes: avoid: Font Size was offered as a looser match for a fractional size difference, but it also needs the exact size; now Font Family & Style only

cards.name: Font Size
cards.summary: Selects every text object set at the same point size as the selected text, in any font. Needs selected text.
use_for: normalising all 9 pt captions to 10 pt
finding text too small for print legibility
checking a type scale for stray sizes
avoid: only one typeface at that size: use Font Family, Style & Size
cards.script_api: No executeMenuCommand id was paired in the harvest; the harvest's fallback is the menu path or Win32 command 2147483832. DOM substitute: compare textFrame.textRange.characterAttributes.size (unverified)

cards.name: Graphic Style
cards.summary: Selects all objects that have the same graphic style (from the Graphic Styles panel) applied as the selected object. Needs a selected reference object.
use_for: updating every button or tag that uses one graphic style
checking where a style is used before deleting it from the Graphic Styles panel
avoid: objects styled by hand to look the same are not caught: use Appearance

cards.name: Opacity
cards.summary: Selects all objects with the same opacity percentage as the selected object (e.g. every 40% overlay). Needs a selected reference object.
use_for: adjusting all semi-transparent overlays or tints together

avoid: 100% opacity matches nearly everything in the file
